name: Table
description: SEED contract for the MUI ORGANISM round — the first ORGANISM through the computed pipeline. Props/axes only; the whole composed DataTable anatomy (head row + 5 columns incl. a checkbox column and a sort-label column, two body rows one of them selected/checked, a right-aligned action cell) is promoted from captured DOM truth via the RECURSIVE childrenSpec tree. NAMED EXCLUSIONS (v1): stickyHeader (position:sticky has no carried spelling); the row overflow menu is captured CLOSED (an open Menu portals a root and the single-portaled-root policy would drop the in-stage table); TableSortLabel direction='asc' only (the direction axis is excluded by name); TableContainer/Paper is not the captured root (axes ride the root mount and `size` is a Table prop); rows are INLINED, not component refs (promotion emits no refs, and MUI's size='small' descendant rule restyles the nested Checkbox's own padding with unchanged child classes). Column widths are deterministic AT THE PINNED STAGE WIDTH — table-layout:auto reflows with available width. NAMED RESIDUE: the schema's semantics vocabulary has no table/thead/tbody/tr/td elements (element=div + role=table, the repo's own ds.table precedent) — the CSS table box model is LOWERED to the flex vocabulary at promotion (table-lowering receipts) rather than growing the bounded grammar with keywords no target renders. Subject: @mui/material@9.2.0 (pinned, examples/mui/PROVENANCE.md). COMPUTED-ENRICHED (extract/computed): unlabeled styled channels minted from computed-style capture of @mui/material@9.2.0 in headless Chromium 149.0.7827.55; overflow channels in the sibling extension file. FLOOR-PROMOTED (examples/mui/scripts/promote-floor.mjs): enriched.contract.json — computed-capture truth; minted leaves source-aliased to MUI's own CSS-variable references where verified (source-bindings.json); extension sidecar carries the named overflow.
